application_family.changes: Only initial pose/pusher coordinates and independent RNG family key; no parameter adjustment
application_family.predeclared_expectation: Same physical/task/range and unchanged learned models, planner, costs, action limits, recording and task criteria should execute on the new settled initial state without parameter adjustment. Contact timing, selected actions and success/termination can change and are measured after the freeze; no outcome is promised. This one same-range family tests application of the frozen implementation, not population generalization, superiority or an additional eight replay runs.
